notes: The lyric highlight is timed by the song itself: each line is placed on the rise in the recording where it is actually sung, so a line moves with the tempo of the take instead of with how many letters it holds.

A song played over the network is measured from the same bytes it is already playing, so its words are no longer spaced by a share of the song length - and the lyric nudge and the word-by-word timing work on those songs too.

When the app has the recording, the model is not asked to invent a rhythm for it: the timing follows the song and gives the same answer every time, and a model that rewrites or translates the words has its timing refused instead of replacing them.
